title: inventory_snapshot
description: Phase 5 Material Recovery Inventory per-source snapshot. An AVAILABILITY layer over the data/materials.json archetypes — it adds NO new materials; the classifier binds each live listing to one of the frozen ids. status is the never-silent-degrade label: a failed fetch is stale_snapshot or unavailable, NEVER an empty 'live'. rejected[] is required (even if empty) so the never-silent-drop conservation seam (accepted + rejected == scraped, D-09) has a place to read. distance_km is a DERIVED road route (Nominatim+OSRM, supplier -> Parc del Forum) or a GROUNDED frozen materials.json fallback — distance_tier carries that provenance. No projected coords: this is a flat scalar-km contract (WGS84-agnostic), so it needs no _defs CRS $ref. availability_window is an OPTIONAL per-listing collect-before-landfill clock (from/until) used by the scheduled-surplus source (festival teardown calendar): from = teardown start, until = the perishability deadline; end_date_proxy=true marks until as a slipping planned end-date hypothesis, NEVER a hard expiry. Existing scrape adapters omit the window (it is non-required); a snapshot whose provenance_tier is ASSUMED carries inferred (not scraped) listings — see the scheduled-surplus adapter.
